changelog:
Initial release of the "cut-as-code" skill entry point.

- Provides structured routing for video editing requests based on Project Protocol V1 artifacts.
- Routes and recovers project state without making editorial, review, or rendering decisions; delegates these to leaf skills.
- Supports multi-operation orchestration, ensuring correct order and prevention of concurrent conflicting modifications.
- Requires explicit project roots and uses `work/project.json` as the sole shared manifest; never infers projects from repository root.
- Ensures user involvement only for missing inputs or genuine ambiguity, never for clear routes or internal choices.
- Includes robust failure handling, always preserving user work and reporting issues without destructive actions.
summary: Use when any cut-as-code request involves understanding, cutting, color grading, adding B-roll, graphic motion, content cards, captions, creating shorts, comparing, rendering, or resuming a Project Protocol V1 video project.
